method.oracle: adaptive triangle integration of the analytic Solovev current density, shared by both representations
method.own_node_quadratic: one centroid plus six own vertices; quadratic flux fit; degree-five triangle density samples; affine density projection
method.cubic_stencil: banked consistent cubic current-density coefficients integrated in closed form
method.m1_normalization: sum of per-cell first-moment error norms divided by oracle absolute current times the hex radius
